In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate ended his relationship with one of his many '''mistresses''', leaving [[Gender/Legends|her]] with an [[Unidentified Imperial City house|extravagant dwelling]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] as a going-away present. As per his relationship custom, Xizor planned to have his personal [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Guri]], bestow upon the ex-mistress a generous severance package, as well as a warning to never attempt to contact Xizor again, lest she be [[Death/Legends|killed]] for trying to do so.
